responsibility: Defines the Rust HIR pattern class hierarchy used for let bindings, match arms, and destructuring. It provides concrete nodes for literal, identifier, wildcard, range, reference, struct, tuple-struct, tuple, slice, and path-based patterns together with helper substructures for range bounds, struct fields, and tuple-pattern item ranges, plus visitor hooks, cloning, mappings, and source locations. This file is the structural representation of pattern syntax after lowering into HIR.
